name: @remonta/db
description: Owns the Prisma schema and migrations for the application database. Schema and tooling only in U8 — see README for why it exports no runtime code yet.
//scripts: These operate on the schema this package owns, but they require AUTH_DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_DATABASE_URL to be present in the environment. Prisma resolves .env relative to where it runs, and the .env file lives in apps/app -- so running these from here fails with P1012 unless the variables are already exported (CI and deploy environments inject them, so they work there). For local use prefer the apps/app scripts, which run from a directory where .env resolves and point --schema back at this package.
